title: 第11章 火铜矮人第11章 开出金了
slug: 领主反派破灭后开始当战犯
content_zh:
火铜矮人，青铜器时代和铁器时代的着名锻造好手，制作出来的武器精良优秀，即使是现在也是一个有名的矮人大族。
只不过随着发展进步，魔法符文时代来临，这就让一部分矮人失去了自己赖以为生的手段。
青铜器时代。
铁器时代。
钢铁时代。
魔法符文时代。
前面的三个时代矮人们只要学好锻造这门手艺活，依靠着自己种族天赋，天生力气大，矮小。
挖矿，炼制，锻造，一条龙服务卖军火。
正如同种族的天赋一样。
每一个种族都有自己的强势期，龙族，精灵，矮人，这三个种族是前期强势，后期因为人口原因逐渐弱势。
矮人虽然不像精灵，龙族生育率那么低，但他们是住在山里的，食物有限，人口自然上不去。
兽人，亚人中期强势，因为有人口加持。
人类在身体素质上完全就是弱鸡，没有锻炼过的人甚至能被哥布林按住。
可是人族是一个聪明的种族，虽然总被别人种族骂虚伪，心机，狡猾，贪婪，傲慢，自大。
那是因为在这群愚蠢的家伙眼里，完全不能理解人类的脑子，和他们聪明的脑回路。
比如说龙族那帮强大的家伙，在人类眼里就是一群傻子，明明有那么强大的力量，还有一群渴望成为龙族的亚龙，结果龙族这群家伙因为瞧不起亚龙，还有其他种族，害的自己统一的世界被各族推翻。
但凡龙族知道什么叫做附属国，仆从国，现在世界肯定还是他们的。
直到最近几百年，龙族出了两任萝莉龙王，建立国家，收附属国，这才让龙族不用担心屠龙勇士去偷家。
同时由于抛弃了他们那原始人的住山洞生活，据说龙族这几百年有很多新龙诞生。
然后这两萝莉龙王被吹上天了。

这制度人类都已经玩了有上万年了！
其他种族也一样。
魔法符文起源于魔族，被人类发扬光大。
青铜器时代就有的东西，在钢铁时代来临后，武器的锻造已经不能让武器更强了，人类就开始研究院什么能加强盔甲，加强武器，然后就把魔法符文发扬光大了。
这个的发展在林恩眼里是属于人类在中世纪这个节点，因为魔法走上了和蓝星人截然不同的两条道路。
在蓝星，手工锻造钢铁时代就陆续有火器出现，对抗逐渐强大的盾，然后工业革命，火枪火炮这个矛大于了盾，让人类更加坚定的走向了工业革命。
如果有魔法呢？
因为魔法吃血统，因为贵族老爷真的有种，平民造反几乎无法成功。
火器的发展也需要时间，蓝星人类都花了好几百年，在这个世界没有人想到把火药塞进管子里发射。
不需要，也没有必要。
魔法斗气是第一，天才们都修炼魔法斗气，自然发展魔导科技，完全巧妙的避开了工业革命。
就如同印第安人一样，因为没有可以拉货的牲畜，所以没有轮子，加上可以随便捕猎，所以没有大力发展农耕，因为没有大力发展农业，人口上不去，没有驯服牲畜，所以没有发明轮子，因为生产力低，铁器时代一直没有发展。
有魔法，天才都去修炼魔法了，所有资源堆魔法。
对面的甲太强了，我们用符文强化武器去破盾吧！
对面的剑太强了，我们用符文强化铠甲护盾吧！
可恶，我需要种田，可是用人力效率太低，太累，怎么办？
我们可以去升级魔兽啊！
运输物资怎么办？
content_en:
The Fire Bronze Dwarves were famous blacksmiths in the Bronze Age and Iron Age. The weapons they produced were exquisite and excellent. Even now they are a famous dwarf clan.
However, with the advancement of development and the advent of the era of magic runes, some dwarves have lost their means of livelihood.
Bronze Age.
Iron Age.
The Age of Steel.
The age of magic runes.
In the previous three eras, the dwarves only had to learn the craft of forging and rely on their racial talents, which meant they were naturally strong and short.
Mining, refining, forging, one-stop service to sell arms.
Just like the talent of the race.
Each race has its own period of strength, dragons, elves, and dwarves. These three races are strong in the early stage, but gradually become weak in the later stage due to population reasons.
Although the fertility rate of dwarves is not as low as that of elves and dragons, they live in the mountains and have limited food, so their population cannot grow.
Orcs and demi-humans are strong in the mid-term because of the population support.
Human beings are completely weak in terms of physical fitness. People who have not exercised can even be held down by goblins.
But the human race is a smart race, although they are always criticized by other races for being hypocritical, scheming, cunning, greedy, arrogant, and arrogant.
That's because in the eyes of these stupid guys, they can't understand the human brain and their clever brain circuits at all.
For example, those powerful guys from the Dragon Clan are just a bunch of fools in the eyes of humans. They are so powerful and have a group of sub-dragons who long to become dragons. As a result, these guys from the Dragon Clan looked down on the sub-dragons and other races, causing their unified world to be overthrown by all races.
As long as the Dragon Clan knows what it means to be a vassal state or a servant state, the world must still be theirs now.
It wasn't until the past few hundred years that the Dragon Clan had two Loli Dragon Kings, established a country, and collected tributary states, so that the Dragon Clan didn't have to worry about dragon-slaying warriors stealing their homes.
At the same time, because they abandoned their primitive cave life, it is said that many new dragons were born in the dragon clan in the past few hundred years.
Then these two loli dragon kings were blown up to the sky.
Humans have been playing with this system for tens of thousands of years!
Same goes for other races.
Magic runes originated from the demon clan and were carried forward by humans.
It was something that existed in the Bronze Age. After the advent of the Iron Age, the forging of weapons could no longer make the weapons stronger. Human beings began to study what could strengthen armor and weapons, and then they carried forward the magic runes.
In Linn's eyes, this development belongs to the point where humans were in the Middle Ages, because magic has taken two completely different paths from the Blue Star people.
In Blue Star, firearms appeared one after another in the age of hand-forged steel to counter the increasingly powerful shields. Then during the Industrial Revolution, guns and artillery became more spears than shields, making mankind more determined to move towards the Industrial Revolution.
What if there was magic?
Because magic eats blood, and because the aristocratic master is really talented, the common people's rebellion is almost impossible to succeed.
The development of firearms also takes time. It took humans on Blue Star hundreds of years. No one in this world thought of putting gunpowder into a tube and firing it.
No need, no need.
Magical fighting spirit is the number one. Geniuses all practice magic fighting spirit and naturally develop magic technology, completely and cleverly avoiding the industrial revolution.
Just like the Indians, because there were no livestock to pull goods, they did not have wheels, and they could hunt at will, so they did not vigorously develop agriculture. Because they did not vigorously develop agriculture, the population could not increase, and they did not tame livestock, so they did not invent the wheel. Because productivity was low, there was no development in the Iron Age.
There is magic, and geniuses have gone to practice magic, and all resources are piled on magic.
The armor on the opposite side is too strong, let’s use rune-enhanced weapons to break the shield!
The sword on the other side is too strong, let's use runes to strengthen the armor shield!
Damn it, I need to farm, but using manpower is too inefficient and too tiring. What should I do?
we canGo and upgrade the World of Warcraft!
What about transporting supplies?
